Senses.Explanation: Neither the ‘by-means-of’ graph (以) nor the ‘eight’ graph (八) is a paired character puzzle: the whole formula asks what graph the visible strokes make if they are not accepted as either familiar character. Chan records keep both halves together and answer through strokes, main text and commentary, or the entire canon. Liao'an uses the pair to open two hall addresses; Baichi asks a canon keeper which graph it is and calls the canon its phonetic gloss; and an unnamed monk puts the same full question to Luohan Guichen.
